specs.label: Engine oil
specs.value: 5W-30, 0W-40 or 5W-40 with Porsche A40 approval. Confirm in manual.

specs.label: Oil capacity
specs.value: 6.3 L (6.7 qt) with filter. Start with 6 qt, then use the dipstick.

specs.label: Oil filter
specs.value: Cartridge, Mahle OX160D or equivalent, new O-ring

specs.label: Drain plug
specs.value: 19 mm, 22 ft-lb, new plug and crush washer

specs.label: Paint
specs.value: Black 041 (solid) or Basalt Black Metallic C9Z. Check the vehicle data sticker to confirm.

specs.label: Brake calipers
specs.value: Red Brembo, not standard on the base V6 (red came on the 955 Turbo). Match pads and rotors to the calipers, not the VIN.

specs.label: Head unit
specs.value: Aftermarket Android unit, not factory PCM. Rockchip-based (model auto_rk_t10), 9-inch screen, 4 GB RAM, 64 GB storage. Aftermarket backup camera wired to it.

todo.title: Replace both headlights
todo.notes: Decided to replace both headlight assemblies. The passenger headlight has water inside the lens; replacing both keeps them matched in color and brightness. Confirm whether the car has halogen or bi-xenon headlights before ordering, since the assemblies differ.

todo.title: Interior dome and rear passenger overhead lights not working
todo.notes: Front dome lights and rear passenger overhead lights are both out. Check the interior lighting fuse first, then bulbs and door switches.

todo.title: Passenger front seat back panel coming off
todo.notes: Rear panel on the passenger seat back is separating. It's held on with double-sided adhesive strips. Fix: remove old adhesive, clean both surfaces with isopropyl alcohol, re-stick with automotive double-sided tape (e.g. 3M VHB or 3M auto attachment tape), press firmly and let it cure.

todo.title: Exhaust leak heard by mechanic
todo.notes: Mechanic who worked on the car heard an exhaust leak; louder than normal but no running problems noticed. Have the source pinpointed (manifold gasket, flex pipe or a joint/clamp). Listen for ticking on cold start and watch for exhaust smell in the cabin.

todo.title: Respray roof and bumper (clear coat), polish and seal the rest
todo.notes: Clear coat failing on the roof and bumper, so those panels need a sand, paint and clear at a body shop; polishing won't fix them. Then a one-step polish and paint sealant on the whole car. Budget about $1,400 to $3,000 all in: bumper $400-800, roof $700-1,500, one-step polish $200-400, sealant $100-250. Paint first, then polish and blend. Wait about 30 days for new paint to cure before sealing it. Paint quotes: Quality Automall (Rutherford), Jersey Auto Body (Passaic), Dynamic Collision (East Rutherford). Polish: JD Auto Detailing (Clifton) or Get Right Mobile Detailing. Ask each body shop if they blend into adjacent panels and whether the roof can be spot-repaired.

todo.title: Replace front wiper blades
todo.notes: Safety item: front wipers streaking and worn out. Easy DIY. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Cooling system hoses are original
todo.notes: Hoses look original. Worth replacing together with the thermostat housing to save on labor and coolant. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Replace spark plugs
todo.notes: Spark plugs worn or fouled. Also on the factory schedule; log it as Spark plugs when done to reset the countdown. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Control arm bushings cracked and torn
todo.notes: Replace the control arms and get an alignment afterward. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208). TJA Auto Care estimate 10/6/2026 (order 11622, valid 30 days): $1,884.60 incl. tax. 2 control arms $1,148 ($574 each), lower bushings R&R 2.5 hr $442.50, four-wheel alignment $177. Shop quoted OEM parts.

todo.title: Front and rear struts look original
todo.notes: Technician flagged them for review, not replacement yet. Ask how they look and ride; plan for them at some point. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Aftermarket backup camera not working
todo.notes: Camera was installed with the aftermarket Android head unit. Check: head unit camera settings (reverse trigger enabled), reverse trigger wire to the reverse light circuit, power to the camera, video cable connection at the back of the head unit, and the camera itself.

todo.title: Loud engine: catalytic converter
todo.notes: TJA mechanic (10/28/2026) said the loud engine sound is mostly from the catalytic converter. It's a costly replacement but not a failure issue, so it can wait. Fuel use still worth tracking over a few fill-ups, and the overdue spark plugs and air filter may help. Get a quote before deciding.
